hook: ASK WHY THREE TIMES|THE TRUTH COMES OUT

voices.name: l00
voices.text: When you hear yourself say just because, <#0.2#> ask why three times.
voices.caption: When you hear yourself say just because, ask why three times.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: I just put it off. <#0.3#> Why? I didn't want to.
voices.caption: I just put it off. Why? I didn't want to.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: And why is that? <#0.3#> I was afraid I'd fail.
voices.caption: And why is that? I was afraid I'd fail.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Ask just three times, <#0.2#> and the real feeling shows itself.
voices.caption: Ask just three times, and the real feeling shows itself.
